notes: Fernwick feels lived in: a closer village camera, a lookout bench to sit on with Biscuit, Mabel serving at the bakery, a mailbox for your letters, and a cabin that starts out furnished.
The fight is about the fish: it thrashes big and in its own colours under your line, with the reel ring now a small readout in the corner.
A calmer screen: one card for the time and your coins, a single Menu button, and hints that tuck away after your first day (F1 or ? brings them back).
A prettier dock: softer reflections, shadows, warm low sunlight, and reeds and rocks in the foreground. Biscuit perks up at nibbles, and a kingfisher sometimes visits your dock post.
Each spot has its own character: fish at The Deep bolt for the bottom, and Lily Cove's lily stems can snag your hook.
A daily tin of 30 worms (more at the shop), and a rare fish that gets away is spooked until tomorrow. Lighting a lantern is now a proper moment: light the wick yourself and watch the village answer.
